scope: Split publish workflow into isolated matrix/dependent jobs and add idempotent pre-publish existence checks for GitHub Packages and npm

tasks.title: Decouple CI/CD Pipeline into Independent Verification and Publish Jobs
tasks.description: Refactor .github/workflows/publish.yml to separate monolithic tasks into independent modular jobs: (1) 'build-and-test' (lint, vitest, build, tarball generation), (2) 'verify-package-managers' (isolated checks for npm, pnpm, yarn with nodeLinker node-modules, and bun), (3) 'publish-github-packages', and (4) 'publish-npm-registry'. Ensure a failure in publish does not require re-running full lint/build suites unnecessarily.

tasks.title: Implement Idempotent Version Existence Guard for GitHub Packages and npm
tasks.description: Fix rerun release failures caused by GitHub Packages rejecting already-published versions ('409 Conflict' / 'version already exists'). Before executing publish commands, query each registry (npm view / npm show / curl registry metadata). If the version already exists in GitHub Packages, log a clean informational warning and safely skip publishing to GitHub Packages while continuing to publish to npm (and vice versa).

tasks.title: Validate Release Pipeline & Synchronize Agent Memory
tasks.description: Validate the updated workflow syntax, ensure secrets and permissions (GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN) are correctly scoped per job, and update .agent/project_summary.md with the decoupled multi-job architecture.
